Rae (Finance): Heads up  we found three prepaid Dedicated invoices where customers changed commitments mid-billing period (INV-2026-0510, INV-2026-0521, INV-2026-0533). Need guidance for 03/31 close entries.

Ethan (Billing): We prorate by days. If a credit memo was issued, the net prepaid amount after the credit is the basis for the deferral schedule.

Priya (RevOps): For consistency: earned = (days actually consumed / total days billed) * net prepaid. Unearned = net prepaid - earned. We'll flag these as "midterm-mod" in the revenue schedule tool so they aren't auto-scheduled in full.

Sam (Accounting): GL mapping: Cash/AR (1010), Deferred/Unearned (2205), Revenue - Dedicated (4002), Customer Credits (2108). JE to recognize earned portion at month end (example amounts below).

Rae (Finance): Can you post the CSV of affected invoices and the credit memo refs? I will compute the JEs and add a one-paragraph memo for the close pack.

Ethan (Billing): Uploaded CSV to #finance-uploads: 1772601234-midterm-prepay.csv. Includes: inv_id, start_date, end_date, original_amount, credit_amount, cm_ref, days_used, days_unearned.

CloseBot: Close reminder for 03/31: attach memos for manual deferral adjustments.

Sam (Accounting): Sample JE (simplified):
Dr Unearned Revenue (2205)  $7,500
Cr Revenue - Dedicated (4002)  $7,500
This assumes $10,000 prepaid, $2,500 unearned after proration/credit.

Priya (RevOps): We'll change the revenue scheduler to emit an "adjustment" line for midterm-mod flagged invoices so Accounting can pick them up automatically next month. Target: small patch before month-end.

Rae (Finance): Thanks  once I run the calculations I'll drop the memo + JE lines in the close pack. If anyone sees a special case in the CSV please ping. :thumbsup:
